page_data.en:
The following is the translation of a circular poster
purporting to have emanated from the Sino-Japanese Citizens
Joint Friendship Union at Fengtien :-

AWAKE IMMEDIATELY, - ALL YE PATRIOTIC CITIZENS OF THE REPUBLIC
OF CHINA !

You all must understand that an armed anti-foreign
movement without a definite policy will only lead to the
detriment of the nation that conducts it. Read the history
of Japan's reformation. During that period, Japan, in spite
of widely spread meaningless anti-foreign movements, was able
nevertheless under the direction of capable men and their
untiring efforts to strengthen Japan's power, promote her
internal affairs and effect reforms relating to politics,
economics, civilization, communications, military, etc.
They continued in their perseverance regardless of all
sacrifices and the result was that Japan succeeded in
abolishing all her unequal treaties.

Having passed through all the abovementioned
vicissitudes, Japan is capable of expressing her entire
sympathy with China and has borne with patience the full
brunt of the anti-Japanese movement which has been conducted
by the Chinese nationals since the establishment of the
Republic of China. Recently certain undesirable elements
amongst the Chinese Kuomintang and militarists, who are
always attempting to realize their own ambition, seized
the opportunity by employing innocent Chinese youths whom
they instigate to resist Japan and spread anti-Japanese
propaganda. Have not those anti-Japanese activities
resulted in creating the present impasse ? The Chinese
masses have made colossal sacrifices for the sake of
conducting the anti-Japanese movement guided by the Chinese
Kuomintang and militarists. What benefits have they
received from it now ? The results of those activities
will make it impossible for China to get rid of all the
unequal treaties and this aimless movement will throw the
Chinese citizens into a state of melancholy.

The outbreak of the Shanghai embroglio was the
climax of anti-propaganda campaign by the Chinese Kuomintang
and unscrupulous dictatorship of the Chinese militarists.
In order to protect her nationals and maintain her dignity,
Japan was forced to resort to armed force in the recent
crisis. The Chinese Kuomintang and militarists utilized
the patriotic aspirations of innocent Chinese youths and
succeeded in enforcing the guileful anti-Japanese propaganda.
The following are some of the propaganda material served up
to the Chinese youths :-
1) Japan's invasion of Korea.
2) Japan's invasion of Manchuria, Port Arthur and
Dairen.
3) Japan's 21 demands.

When a careful study of Japan's policy is made,
it will be seen that this form of anti-Japanese propaganda
is fundamentally erroneous. Let us consider the history
of the Korean problem. At that time, discussions took
place throughout Korea and proved that there existed a real
understanding of the Imperial spirit of Japan. Furthermore,
the late Emperor of Korea, endeavouring to liberate himself
and his people from the oppression of the white races, upheld
the peace of the Far East and preserved the prosperity of
his nationals, recognizing that the unification of Korea and

以下是一份据称发自奉天“中日公民联合亲善会”的循环张贴海报的译文：——

立即觉醒吧，中华民国的全体爱国公民们！

你们都必须明白，没有明确政策的武装排外运动只会给发起该运动的国家带来损害。请阅读日本改革的历史。在那段时期，尽管日本国内广泛存在着毫无意义的排外运动，但在能人的指导和他们不懈的努力下，日本得以增强国力，促进内政，并实施涉及政治、经济、文明、交通、军事等方面的改革。他们不顾一切牺牲，坚持到底，结果日本成功废除了所有不平等条约。

经历了上述种种变迁后，日本有能力表达对中国的全面同情，并耐心承受了自中华民国建立以来中国国民所发起的反日运动的全部冲击。最近，中国国民党及军人中某些不良分子，总是试图实现其个人野心，利用无辜的中国青年，煽动他们抵抗日本并散布反日宣传。难道不是这些反日活动造成了目前的僵局吗？中国民众为了进行由中国国民党和军人指导的反日运动，做出了巨大的牺牲。他们现在从中得到了什么好处？这些活动的结果将使中国无法摆脱所有不平等条约，这种无目的的运动将使中国公民陷入忧郁状态。

上海事变的爆发是中国国民党反宣传运动的高潮，也是中国军人肆无忌惮的独裁统治的结果。为了保护其国民并维护其尊严，日本在最近的危机中被迫诉诸武力。中国国民党和军人利用了无辜中国青年的爱国热情，成功推行了狡诈的反日宣传。以下是向中国青年提供的一些宣传材料：
1) 日本入侵朝鲜。
2) 日本入侵满洲、旅顺和大连。
3) 日本的二十一条要求。

如果仔细研究日本的政策，就会发现这种形式的反日宣传从根本上就是错误的。让我们考虑一下朝鲜问题的历史。当时，整个朝鲜进行了讨论，证明存在对日本帝国精神的真正理解。此外，已故朝鲜皇帝为了将自己和人民从白种人的压迫中解放出来，维护远东和平并保持其国民的繁荣，认识到朝鲜与

（左侧手写批注：7月 31/3）

page_data.en:
( 2 )

Japan was the only salvation. The unification of Japan
and Korea then followed. Since then the Japanese
Government has respected the family of the late Emperor of
Korea as if it were its own Emperor's.
With regard to the Manchurian problem, Japan, as
the result of repeated oppressions and insults suffered by
her ancestors from Europeans and Americans and likewise, in
order to protect herself and maintain peace in the Far East,
exerted her very utmost and only now has she received the
glory for it. China who shoulders half the responsibility
of the Far East should undertake the same efforts as those
performed by Japan, but China on the contrary pays no
attention to such a matter of importance and misunderstands
Japan's friendship with her.
During the Russo-Japanese war, although it was
stated that the Chinese Ching Dynasty suffered from Russian
oppression, it nevertheless entered into secret treaties
with Russia, the object being to suppress Japan, and which
resulted in the lease to Russia of Port Arthur and allowing
Russia to establish railways and station troops in Manchuria.
Manchuria then resembled a Russian settlement, which
circumstance led Russia almost to seize Japan through Korea.
The upshot of this was to lead Russia to annex China. In
order to maintain the dignity of her homeland and uphold
peace in the Far East, Japan was forced to declare war on
Russia with the result that Japan defeated Russia and
Fengtien, Kirin, Heilungkiang and Mongolia were all restored
back to China. In return for these services, Japan secured
only the privileges formerly held by Russia. Can it be
said that Japan invaded China? Can Japan's acts of
righteousness in defeating Russia be regarded as ambition?
The Shantung question was settled in a similar manner. Did
not Japan return Tsingtao to China and was this not effected
by the declaration of the Japanese Minister of Foreign Affairs?
Look at the map of the Far East and see how the
color of the majority of the territory was changed by the
white men who arbitrarily committed their greatest spoliation.
Had Japan been defeated in the Russo-Japanese war, the map
of the Far East would have been altered and we would all
have been slaves under the yoke of the white men.
China has failed to recognize the merits of Japan
and has neglected her favours to China. The Chinese
Government established after the revolution flattered the
far distant European nations and America but refused to consider
consider the difficult work Japan performed in the Far East.
As a consequence, the Far East has gradually become more
dangerous, which circumstance brought about the situation
that forced Japan to submit the 21 demands to China.
Some time later, the Chinese nationals gradually
awakened and consequently the 21 demands with the exception
of one or two clauses were abolished. If a careful study
be made of the Sino-Japanese situation, Can Japan be accused
of enforcing her policy of invasion? Should Japan really
possess the ambition of invasion, what excuse could she offer
to the world for such a step, while all the Powers are glaring
at her like a tiger? Japan only hopes that China will
endorse her policy in Manchuria, which will appease the
population there and permit the Japanese surplus population
to obtain a livelihood in that territory. It is regrettable
that the majority of the Chinese people share the opinion
that Japan intends to occupy Manchuria and transform it into
a colony. This idea is an absolutely mistaken one.
page_data.zh:
( 2 )

日本的统一是唯一的出路。随后日本与朝鲜实现了统一。此后，日本政府尊重已故朝鲜皇帝的家族，如同尊重其本国天皇家族一样。
关于满洲问题，日本由于其祖先遭受欧洲人和美国人的反复压迫和侮辱，同时也为了保护自身并维护远东和平，尽了最大努力，直到现在才因此获得荣耀。承担远东一半责任的中国本应承担与日本相同的努力，但中国反而对此类重要事项不予关注，并误解了日本对其的友谊。
在日俄战争期间，虽然据说中国清朝遭受了俄罗斯的压迫，但它仍与俄罗斯签订了秘密条约，目的是压制日本，这导致将旅顺租借给俄罗斯，并允许俄罗斯在满洲修建铁路和驻扎军队。当时满洲类似于俄罗斯的租界，这种情况导致俄罗斯几乎通过朝鲜控制日本。其结果是导致俄罗斯吞并中国。为了维护祖国的尊严和维护远东和平，日本被迫对俄罗斯宣战，结果日本击败了俄罗斯，奉天、吉林、黑龙江和蒙古全部归还给中国。作为对这些服务的回报，日本仅获得了以前由俄罗斯持有的特权。能说日本入侵了中国吗？日本击败俄罗斯的正义行为能被视为野心吗？山东问题也是以类似方式解决的。日本不是将青岛归还给了中国吗？这不是由日本外务大臣的声明实现的吗？
看看远东地图，看看大部分领土的颜色是如何被任意进行最大掠夺的白人改变的。如果日本在日俄战争中战败，远东地图将会改变，我们都将成为白人枷锁下的奴隶。
中国未能认识到日本的功绩，忽视了对中国的恩惠。革命后建立的中国政府奉承遥远的欧洲国家和美国，却拒绝考虑日本在远东所做的艰难工作。因此，远东逐渐变得更加危险，这种情况导致了迫使日本向中国提出二十一条要求的局面。
一段时间后，中国国民逐渐觉醒，因此除了一两条条款外，二十一条要求被废除。如果仔细研究中日局势，能指责日本推行其入侵政策吗？如果日本真的拥有入侵的野心，在所有列强如虎视眈眈般盯着她的情况下，她能为这一步骤向世界提供什么借口？日本只希望中国认可其在满洲的政策，这将安抚当地人口，并允许日本过剩人口在该地区谋生。令人遗憾的是，大多数中国人持有日本意图占领满洲并将其变为殖民地的观点。这个想法绝对是错误的。

page_data.en:
( 3 )

You must all understand that the present movement
which is being conducted by the Chinese people is neither
patriotic nor anti-foreign, but will lead to the ruination
of China. Were China in a position to protect foreign
residents and permit them to enjoy judicial privileges the
same as Chinese citizens, the foreign nations would never
want to waste such colossal expenditure or wear out their
energy to obtain the right of extraterritoriality.
We sincerely hope the patriotic people of China
will never allow themselves to be deluded by the Chinese
Kuomintang and militarists and will settle all their
misunderstandings between China and Japan in a perfectly just
manner. Simultaneously, we hope the Japanese people will
not flout their superior complex to the Chinese. Both
nations should adopt a spirit of conciliation and set about
with the object of maintaining peace in the Far East.

〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
( 3 )

你们都必须明白，目前中国人民进行的这场运动既非爱国也非排外，而是会导致中国的毁灭。如果中国能够保护外国居民并允许他们享有与中国公民相同的司法特权，外国列强绝不会愿意浪费如此巨大的开支或耗费精力去获得治外法权。
我们真诚希望中国的爱国人民绝不被中国国民党和军人所迷惑，并以完全公正的方式解决中日之间的所有误会。同时，我们希望日本人民不要对中国表现出优越感。两国都应采取和解精神，着手维护远东和平。

〔此处转录不清〕

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3432.
Date 31 / 3 / 32.

March 23 32.

Dear Field,

In compliance with your request of today,
I am sending herewith one of the handbills to which
reference is made on page 2 of the Daily Intelligence
Summary. When the item caught my eye I obtained one of
the handbills and had an examination made of it by my
personal Chinese clerk who tells me that the text of the
leaflet as a whole does not justify the conclusion that
it aims at bringing Asiatics together on an anti-"White"
basis, although the member of my staff responsible for the
paragraph in the Daily Intelligence Report seems to have
made this deduction. A full translation of the leaflet
is now being made and a copy will be sent to you in due
course.

Yours sincerely,

〔签名〕

Captain L. F. Field,
Military Headquarters.

sent on March 31.

OF CHINA !

You all must understand that an armed anti-foreign
movement without a definite policy will only lead to the
detriment of the nation that conducts it. Read the history
of Japan's reformation. During that period, Japan, in spite
of widely spread meaningless anti-foreign movements, was able
nevertheless under the direction of capable men and their
untiring efforts to strengthen Japan's power, promote her
internal affairs and effect reforms relating to politics,
economics, civilization, communications, military, etc.
They continued in their perseverance regardless of all
sacrifices and the result was that Japan succeeded in
abolishing all her unequal treaties.

Having passed through all the abovementioned
vicissitudes, Japan is capable of expressing her entire
sympathy with China and has borne with patience the full
brunt of the anti-Japanese movement which has been conducted
by the Chinese nationals since the establishment of the
Republic of China. Recently certain undesirable elements
amongst the Chinese Kuomintang and militarists, who are
always attempting to realize their own ambition, seized
the opportunity by employing innocent Chinese youths whom
they instigate to resist Japan and spread anti-Japanese
propaganda. Have not these anti-Japanese activities
resulted in creating the present impasse ? The Chinese
masses have made colossal sacrifices for the sake of
conducting the anti-Japanese movement guided by the Chinese
Kuomintang and militarists. What benefits have they
received from it now ? The results of these activities
will make it impossible for China to get rid of all the
unequal treaties and this aimless movement will throw the
Chinese citizens into a state of melancholy.

The outbreak of the Shanghai embroglio was the
climax of anti-propaganda campaign by the Chinese Kuomintang
and unscrupulous dictatorship of the Chinese militarists.

Japan was forced to resort to armed force in the recent
crisis. The Chinese Kuomintang and militarists utilized
the patriotic aspirations of innocent Chinese youths and

Japan was the only salvation. The unification of Japan
and Korea then followed. Since then the Japanese
Government has respected the family of the late Emperor of
Korea as if it were its own Emperor's.
With regard to the Manchurian problem, Japan, as
the result of repeated oppressions and insults suffered by
her ancestors from Europeans and Americans and likewise, in
order to protect herself and maintain peace in the Far East,
exerted her very utmost and only now has she received the
glory for it. China who shoulders half the responsibility
of the Far East should undertake the same efforts as those
performed by Japan, but China on the contrary pays no
attention to such a matter of importance and misunderstands
Japan's friendship with her.
During the Russo-Japanese war, although it was
stated that the Chinese Ching Dynasty suffered from Russian
oppression, it nevertheless entered into secret treaties
with Russia, the object being to suppress Japan, and which
resulted in the lease to Russia of Port Arthur and allowing
Russia to establish railways and station troops in Manchuria.
Manchuria then resembled a Russian settlement, which
circumstance led Russia almost to seize Japan through Korea.
The upshot of this was to lead Russia to annex China! In
order to maintain the dignity of her Homeland and uphold
peace in the Far East, Japan was forced to declare war on
Russia with the result that Japan defeated Russia and
Fengtien, Kirin, Heilungkiang and Mongolia were all restored
back to China. In return for these services, Japan secured
only the privileges formerly held by Russia. Can it be
said that Japan invaded China ? Can Japan's acts of
righteousness in defeating Russia be regarded as ambition ?
The Shantung question was settled in a similar manner. Did
not Japan return Tsingtao to China and was this not effected
by the declaration of the Japanese Minister of Foreign Affairs?
Look at the map of the Far East and see how the
color of the majority of the territory was changed by the
white men who arbitrarily committed their greatest spoliation.
Had Japan been defeated in the Russo-Japanese war, the map
of the Far East would have been altered and we would all
have been slaves under the yoke of the white men.
China has failed to recognize the merits of Japan
and has neglected her favours to China. The Chinese
Government established after the revolution flattered the
far distant European nations and America but refused to consider
consider the difficult work Japan performed in the Far East.
As a consequence, the Far East has gradually become more
dangerous, which circumstance brought about the situation
that forced Japan to submit the 21 demands to China.
Some time later, the Chinese nationals gradually
awakened and consequently the 21 demands with the exception
of one or two clauses were abolished. If a careful study
be made of the Sino-Japanese situation, Can Japan be accused
of enforcing her policy of invasion ? Should Japan really
possess the ambition of invasion, what excuse could she offer
to the world for such a step, while all the Powers are glaring
at her like a tiger ? Japan only hopes that China will
endorse her policy in Manchuria, which will appease the
population there and permit the Japanese surplus population
to obtain a livelihood in that territory. It is regrettable
that the majority of the Chinese people share the opinion
that Japan intends to occupy Manchuria and transform it into
a colony. This idea is an absolutely mistaken one.

日本的合并是唯一的救星。随后日本与朝鲜实现合并。自此，日本政府对待已故朝鲜皇帝之家族，犹如对待其本国天皇家族一般尊崇。
关于满洲问题，日本因祖先屡受欧美人士之压迫与侮辱，且为自卫及维持远东和平起见，已竭尽所能，直至今日方获此荣耀。中国肩负远东半数之责任，本应付出与日本同等之努力，然中国反而对此等要务漠不关心，并误解日本对华之友好情谊。
日俄战争期间，虽称中国清朝遭受俄国压迫，但其仍与俄国订立密约，旨在压制日本，致使旅顺港租借予俄国，并允许俄国在满洲修筑铁路及驻军。当时满洲宛如俄国租界，此种情势导致俄国几乎欲借朝鲜以攫取日本。其最终结果将是促使俄国吞并中国！为维护祖国尊严及维持远东和平，日本被迫对俄宣战，结果日本击败俄国，奉天、吉林、黑龙江及蒙古均归还中国。作为对这些功绩的回报，日本仅获得了俄国先前享有的特权。岂能说日本侵略了中国？日本击败俄国的义举岂能被视为野心？山东问题亦以类似方式解决。日本难道未将青岛归还中国？此举难道不是由日本外务大臣宣言所实现的吗？请观远东地图，可见大部分领土之色标如何被白人任意更改，彼等肆意进行了最大程度的掠夺。若日本在日俄战争中战败，远东地图必将改写，而我等皆将成为白人枷锁下的奴隶。
中国未能认可日本之功绩，亦忽视了日本对华之恩惠。革命后建立的中国政府谄媚遥远的欧洲各国及美国，却拒绝考量（原文重复 consider）日本在远东所进行的艰巨工作。因此，远东局势逐渐趋于危险，此种情势迫使日本向中国提出二十一條要求。
不久之后，中国国民逐渐觉醒，因而除一两条款外，二十一條要求已被废除。若仔细研究中日局势，岂能指责日本推行其侵略政策？若日本真具侵略野心，在各列强如虎般眈眈注视之下，她能为此举向世界提供何种借口？日本仅希望中国认可其在满洲之政策，以此安抚当地民众，并使日本过剩人口能在该地谋生。令人遗憾的是，大多数中国人持有日本意图占领满洲并将其变为殖民地之观点。此想法绝对错误。
